sum: Construction Partners, Inc., a civil infrastructure company, provides construction and maintenance of roadways in the United States. The company offers various products and services to public and private infrastructure projects, including highways, roads, bridges, airports, and commercial and residential developments. It also manufactures and distributes hot-mix asphalt for internal use, as well as sales to third parties in connection with construction projects; and sells mining aggregates, such as sand, gravel, and construction stone used as raw material in the production of HMA and to third parties. In addition, the company is involved in paving activities, including the construction of roadway base layers and application of asphalt pavement; and site development, such as installation of utility and drainage systems; and distribution of liquid asphalt cement. The company was formerly known as SunTx CPI Growth Company, Inc. and changed its name to Construction Partners, Inc. in September 2017. Construction Partners, Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Dothan, Alabama.
ceo: Mr. Fred J. Smith III (President, CEO & Director)
